item.description: The AsyncResultBuilder's _send method has incorrect handling of StopIteration and RuntimeError exceptions that leads to "Task got bad yield" and "coroutine raised StopIteration" errors when processing async generators.
item.contract: Modify the _send method in AsyncResultBuilder to properly handle StopIteration and RuntimeError exceptions for async generators. When StopIteration is raised with a value, return that value wrapped in Ok; when StopIteration is raised without a value, return zero(). When RuntimeError occurs, convert it to a proper StopIteration to maintain compatibility.

item.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder's _send method has incorrect handling of StopIteration and RuntimeError exceptions that leads to "Task got bad yield" and "coroutine raised StopIteration" errors when processing async generators.
item.contract: Modify the _send method in AsyncOptionBuilder to properly handle StopIteration and RuntimeError exceptions for async generators. When StopIteration is raised with a value, return that value wrapped in Some; when StopIteration is raised without a value, return zero(). When RuntimeError occurs, convert it to a proper StopIteration to maintain compatibility.

item.description: The AsyncResultBuilder's _send method incorrectly handles exception types when processing Error results, causing "TypeError: exceptions must derive from BaseException" errors.
item.contract: Modify the _send method in AsyncResultBuilder to correctly handle exception wrapping when yielding Error values. Ensure that when an exception is raised during await of an Error, it's properly wrapped in Error rather than raising the raw exception.

item.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder's _send method has improper handling of Nothing values that causes "ValueError: Cannot await Nothing" errors when awaiting Nothing values.
item.contract: Modify the _send method in AsyncOptionBuilder to properly handle awaitable Nothing values by treating them as short-circuit conditions that return Nothing without attempting to await them further.

item.description: The AsyncResultBuilder's __call__ method has incorrect handling of StopIteration exceptions during execution that prevents proper completion of async generators.
item.contract: Update the AsyncResultBuilder.__call__ method to properly catch and handle StopIteration exceptions that may be raised during execution of async generators, ensuring that values are extracted correctly and that the builder completes properly.
